title: fix(plugin-list): Display menu closes after a layout is chosen (objectui#12621)
body:
Fixes #12621
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- `ViewSettingsPopover` (the list toolbar's Display menu) keeps owning its open state; its `layout` slot is now a function of `closeMenu`, and the menu closes through its controlled `setOpen(false)`, so Radix returns focus to the Display trigger exactly as on Escape or an outside click.
- `ListView` passes the switcher through that slot and calls `closeMenu()` when a layout is picked, in both switcher shapes (the segmented control for 2 to 4 visualizations and the nested dropdown for 5 or more).
- The panel's toggles (row numbers, inline edit, density, hidden fields, group, color) do not call it, so they keep the menu open.
- `ViewSettingsPopover` is package-internal (not exported from the `@object-ui/plugin-list` entry), so the slot's type change has one caller and no public surface moves.

## Mechanism (A1 measured)

A1 is refuted. The popover was already controlled (`open` + `onOpenChange={setOpen}`); nothing swallowed a close and no `onEscapeKeyDown` was prevented. The producer of target 1 is the absence of any close on a layout choice: the `layout` slot was an opaque node, and the switcher's `onViewChange` reached `handleViewChange` only. A throwaway probe on base `63d00da3d` (happy-dom, deleted before commit) read: after choosing Kanban the content stays mounted (target 1 reproduced); Escape closes the menu both before and after a choice.

## Tests

New `ListView.displayMenuClose-12621.test.tsx` (4 tests), run from the repo root at HEAD `882ce9b30`:

- choosing Kanban in the segmented Layout row closes the menu and focuses the trigger
- choosing Kanban in the nested Layout dropdown closes the menu and focuses the trigger
- Escape closes the menu and focuses the trigger
- control: toggling Row numbers and cycling density keep the menu open

Ablation (fix committed first; mutation = delete the `closeMenu();` line in `ListView`, anchor count 1 then 0, trap-restored with `git checkout HEAD`, restore proven by empty `git diff HEAD` and a matching HEAD blob hash): `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`; the two choice pins went red, Escape and the control stayed green, as predicted. The tests import `../ListView` from source, so no `dist/` rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

## Gates (HEAD `882ce9b30`)

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' build`: exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check`: exit 0 (`tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` includes the new test file)
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/`: exit 0, `Test Files 139 passed (139)`, `Tests 1453 passed (1453)`
- eslint narrowed to the 3 changed source files with `--no-inline-config --format json`: exit 0, 3 files, 0 errors. Population: all 3 resolve under `eslint.config.js` (`--print-config`). Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`/`projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. `ListView.tsx` warning count equals its base count.
- Battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new).
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, NOT MEASURED: it refuses without a full workspace build (`no-artifact`), recorded per the dispatch, not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED in a real browser: the card's walk saw Escape fail to close the menu after a Kanban choice in the console. happy-dom does not reproduce that (Escape closes in every probe). After this change the menu is already closed once a layout is chosen, so that sequence no longer arises; a real-browser Escape reading before any choice was not taken.
- Choosing the layout that is already active does not close the menu: `ViewSwitcherDropdown` returns before `onViewChange` for the current view. Left as is (no choice was made).
- File surface: the `layout=` prop lines on the `ViewSettingsPopover` element in `ListView.tsx` are edited although `ListView` does not own the open state; they are the Display popover's mount, and closing on choice needs the switcher's callback. Declared in the report.
